# VRB Web Design & Development

> VRB Web Design & Development provides custom website design, web development, UX/UI design, website maintenance, and social media management services for businesses.

## Services

- Website Design: Custom responsive website design for small businesses and growing companies.
- Custom Web Development: Custom websites, web applications, integrations, backend functionality, and scalable web platforms.
- UX/UI Design: User experience strategy, interface design, responsive design systems, prototypes, and website design packages.
- Website Redesign: Visual, structural, responsive, and user experience improvements for existing websites.
- Website Maintenance: Ongoing website support, updates, optimization, and maintenance plans.
- Social Media Management: Content planning, branded graphics, captions, scheduling, publishing, and performance reporting.

## Website Packages

- Website Essentials: Professional website design for small businesses requiring a polished and responsive online presence.
- Professional Website: Custom website design and development for growing businesses requiring greater functionality and flexibility.
- Custom Platform: Custom web development for businesses requiring advanced workflows, integrations, authentication, databases, APIs, and scalable platform architecture.

## Design Packages

- Design Essentials: Entry-level website design and UX foundation.
- Design Foundation: UX/UI design services including strategy, information architecture, responsive UI direction, and high-fidelity mockups.
- Design Signature: Advanced user experience design services including UX strategy, interface systems, prototypes, and developer handoff.

## Additional Information

VRB Web Design & Development works with businesses remotely and provides custom digital solutions based on individual project requirements.
